card.name: Punctuation in dictionary entries for long
card.fires_on: Punctuation or the word to right after an example sentence inside a dictionary entry for the word long, such as as long as, before long, or not long.

modes.label: Sentence end after example
modes.description: The period closing an example sentence about time and duration, just before the next sense begins.
modes.example: Try to keep going for as long as possible<<. >>It took me longer than I thought it

modes.label: Colon or to in definitions
modes.description: A colon or the word to in the gloss that says what a sense of long is used to express.
modes.example: used to say that one thing can happen or be true only if another thing happens or is true<<: >>You can go out to play as long

card.writes: It slightly favors the word once and similar words, with no clear link to the context.
card.plain: It fires at the joints between senses and examples in a dictionary entry on the word long.
